text:
mia: heads-up — noticed a huge spike in console LCP and slow charts after last night's telemetry roll. charts freeze ~1.5-3s per interaction. anyone else?
sam: saw it on staging earlier. heatmap and metrics panels worst.
nina: attached heapview: main-thread parse up +30% in production. suspect new telemetry shim bundle pulled in heavy i18n chunk.
mia: repro steps: open org dashboard, switch date range, hover legend. CPU spikes, devtools shows parse on "telemetry-shim.js" ~400ms. stack shows source: initTelemetry().
josh: could be the shim's eager init. we changed sampling to full capture and imported the sampler at top-level. pinging deploy-bot for roll history.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-20T23:14:02 by @nina rolled telemetry sampler v1.9.4 -> v1.10.0 (canary -> stable) :rocket:
sam: also saw kvcache miss rate increase — more routing weight to EU canary caused more cold bundles in EU edge. that plus bigger telemetry chunk = double whammy.
nina: i can revert the eager import in canary, but want quick mitigation. option: lazy-init sampler on user-interaction (hover/click) or dynamic import.
kelly: alternative: downgrade sampling to 10% while we investigate. reduces telemetry payload and possibly bundle size due to conditional imports.
mia: quick profiling snippet:
```txt
Main: parse telemetry-shim.js 420ms
Main: chart-worker msg parse 80ms
Network: telemetry POST payload +25kb per event
```
ops-bot: alert: frontend-telemetry error rate +12% since 23:20 UTC, cpu throttling alarms triggered.
josh: patch idea: wrap top-level import in if (window.__REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN) { await import('telemetry/sampler') } else defer. PR in flight -> #PR-882
sam: if we throttle telemetry we need to ensure routing policies don't favor canary EU nodes — cause of cache churn. suggest temp routing weight shift back to baseline to stabilize caches.
nina: doing a canary rollback now for canary hosts in eu-west-1
deploy-bot: rollback started 2026-03-21T00:02:10 by @nina -> telemetry sampler v1.9.4
mia: after rollback, preliminary looks better: LCP drop ~600ms on sample page. still monitoring.
kelly: follow-ups: - add unit test ensuring telemetry lazy-loads - add dashboard graph for telemetry bundle parse time - update rollout checklist to include "bundle size / eager imports" checkbox
josh: also let's add a small registry for runtime feature flags so we can flip sampling quickly without redeploy.
mia: thanks team. keeping this thread as action log. will open an incident ticket with timeline and perf numbers later.
